newsitem.title: USA: Mobil has new find offshore Guinea.
newsitem.headline: Mobil has new find offshore Guinea.

text.p: Mobil Corp said Monday a Zafiro satellite field has been discovered offshore Equatorial Guinea in West Africa.

The Rubi-1 wildcat in Block B discovered oil in a reservoir not previously seen in the area, within the Qua Iboe Formation, Mobil said. The reservoir, now called the Rubi Sand, has excellent reservoir properties similar to the shallower reservoirs in the Zafiro Field.
The new Rubi Field is about two miles southeast of the Zafiro 1 well, which discovered the Zafiro oil Field. Mobil has 75 percent, United Meridian Corp 25 percent.
Mobil said the well flowed at a controlled rate of 4,317 barrels of oil and 1.98 million cubic feet of natural gas per day from a limited test interval above the main Rubi sand section.
The well has been suspended for future completion.
The Rubi Field will be developed as a satellite to the larger Zafiro Field and will utilize the "Zafiro Producer", a floating production, storage and offloading system.

Production from the Zafiro field began in August and is currently approaching 40,000 barrels per day, Mobil said. Production should double during the next few years as drilling of development wells continues.
It said production from the Rubi field will extend the peak production rate of the Zafiro field.
